responsibility: This target header specializes the 32-bit GNU/Linux SPARC configuration. It defines Linux/SPARC preprocessor macros, assembler and linker specs, cc1 self-specs, data type defaults, long-double sizing, TLS and stack-check settings, glibc profiling/SSP conventions, executable-stack signaling, and optional -mcpu/-mtune=native driver hooks, thereby binding the generic SPARC backend to the 32-bit Linux ELF ABI and toolchain behavior.
